in_marathi.name: Sulochana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beautiful, radiant, splendid
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sulochana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sulochana is a beautiful, radiant, and splendid name derived from the Sanskrit words su (good, excellent) and lochana (eyes, gaze). It suggests a gentle, graceful, and elegant woman whose beauty is akin to the moon, night, lotus, and moonlight.
